reviews.title: Maps Are Wrong and Politcal
reviews.text:
It would seem the political opinions of the developers and who ever is running this app, have propagated into the app itself.  To avoid controversy, they have removed the name a the Gulf of America (Mexico) and the Great Lakes.    

You know weather is just so political.  🙄. Come on people grow up!  You want to report the weather and be respected, you could at least follow the lead of NOAA and the NWS.  

Every administration regardless of party goes and changes names of landmarks, mountains, bodies of water and roads, our fricking weather radar app should be the last place we see someone taking sides. It just childish.

reviews.title: Previous version was better
reviews.text: (I would’ve given 5 stars for the previous version) When I’m looking for a weather app I want concise, accurate, timely information. Not AI summaries with different personalities (Thetes Carrot weather for that), and widgets that clutter the screen . I’ve had this app for at least 7 years, and up until recently it was my go-to for best radar, best layers, because it was so straightforward. Now you can choose between “pro” and “classic”, but why? The “pro” version isn’t professional. It’s loaded with completely unnecessary features. Some of the radar layers that were present on the previous version are gone. No more GOES layer. The “classic” setting ISN’T classic. Sure, it’s more streamlined than “pro” but the layout is slightly different, and also lacks the layer options found in the previous version. I really wish app developers, like car manufacturers, would realize that you shouldn’t change a good thing for the sake of having something new. Don’t fix something that isn’t broken. I’m very disappointed by this “updated” version.   There is no other app that is as streamlined as the previous version of Storm, and none as accurate. There are now many weather apps that offer far more professional features, but it seems they’re geared more for storm chasers since chasing is trendy now, but many of us aren’t.

reviews.title: Storm radar
reviews.text:
Graphs are difficult to read and decipher.
To view future radar you must scroll in the opposite direction. I can’t believe someone thought this was a good idea.
Auto play comes on at launch even though I have it disabled. Cloud cover, along with other features, used to be free. Now you have to pay. I’ve had this app for years, and after downloading updates, it becomes worse with each one. The cursor used to pinpoint each location after selecting a location. Now it remains fixed. When I click the drop down arrow, the app goes into a loop or just locks up. Can’t wait to see what downgrades await me after the next update.
True to form, the latest update added a useless Beta feature in exchange for screwing up the hourly feature. Instead of showing sky conditions by the hour, there are just straight lines shaped like a tornado.
I just wonder if anyone tests these updates before releasing them or if these bugs are intentional.

reviews.title: Great to Greedy
reviews.text: Awhile ago I liked this app. It was a 5 star great source of information. That said, I really am unhappy with the latest updates/downgrades. Before the latest changes I had the layer options of seeing lightning & storm tracks. Hail and all sorts of great information. Future radar was taken away on the latest updateToday the app says I need to upgrade to premium to see those layers I previously had. What the heck?.. It’s a Bait and switch method that is not appreciated. Most apps increase capabilities as they evolve. This one is trending the other direction. The weather channels greed has now ruined both the Storm & Wunderground Apps. To the developers, please note: Because you took away capabilities and then turned around to sell them back, I will not get the premium upgrade. I’ll keep my $ based on principle alone. If you are looking for a good weather radar, I suggest you look for another app that will not decrease its capabilities over the life of the application.

reviews.title: Terrible Update
reviews.text: The ergonomics of the update weren’t terrible but the quality control is terrible. Alerts were set to my location only, and yet after the update I was getting alerts for all my saved locations, despite having no alerts under those locations in settings. Turned off notifications, added then deleted notifications for other locations and still getting them for all saved locations. Figured it was an update glitch so I deleted and reinstalled that app knowing the pain of re-adding my save locations. Well, now I have to create an account to get into the app. Why? So the silly AI knows it’s me OR perhaps you just want my email so you can sell it. Whelp, kiss off. Made my choice easy. I have plenty of other apps and the new UI was a step backwards anyway. So yeah, see ya weather channel. Seems like whatever you touch you ruin (thinking of all the other great weather apps you’ve managed to bring under your umbrella).

reviews.title: Overcomplicated
